parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The new description of the gateway. The description can be 0 to 255 characters in length.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The new name of the gateway. The name must be 1 to 60 characters in length. It can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, Chinese characters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), or hyphens (-). The name must start with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, or a Chinese character.
